_comment: Machine-readable AI roadmaps behind the progress artifact. The wrapper (run-progress-audit.ps1) uses ONLY the dates here to compute each team's EXPECTED phase on the trigger date; the prompt judges ACTUAL position against the exit criteria. Edit this file when a roadmap changes - never hard-code dates in the prompt or wrapper.

artifact.title: AI & Agentic Progress - Planning with Leads
artifact._pointsNote: Fallback only. Points per phase are resolved PER TEAM: an explicit team-level pointsPerPhase wins, else 100 divided by that team's own phase count. A score always means 'percent of your own plan', so two teams on the same number are NOT necessarily at the same maturity.

teams._anchorNote: IMPACT states relative weeks, not dates. anchorDate = the Monday of roadmap week 1. DEFAULTED to the page's first checkpoint - CONFIRM WITH LEO. A wrong anchor shifts every expected-phase calculation for this team.

teams.title: FAM AI Orchestration Roadmap
teams._anchorNote: FAM states explicit calendar windows and sprint numbers, so no anchorDate is needed.
teams._skillsPathNote: FAM's skills live in the DocumentEntry repo, not in ai-resources. No folder here to count, so skill-count evidence is skipped; progress comes from trigger notes and the ADO item count in the roadmap.
teams._pointsNote: TWO phases, not five. pointsPerPhase is 50 so a completed roadmap still reads 100%. Do not compare this number to a five-phase team's number as if they meant the same thing.
teams.overallGoal: Complete a skill set for AI-assisted ticket cycle workflows by mid-September, then drive adoption to establish whether the process genuinely accelerates work compared to manual approaches.

phases.name: Complete the skill set
exit: all 10 spec skills merged

phases.name: Make it stick
phases._proposedNote: Proposed scope, NOT tracked in ADO and no owners assigned. The roadmap itself says the initiative may close on 15 Sep at the champions' discretion. Do not mark FAM 'Behind' on phase 2 while it remains untracked - report it as proposed.

risks: Momentum drift - a six-sprint timeline risks deprioritisation despite deliberate slack
Phase 1 is only ~15 days of actual effort spread over six weeks
Phase 2 is untracked - wish lists lose to tracked work every time
Drift: an MCP migration to action-based tools broke every existing skill's ADO calls; six files patched, two skills still broken
